# Head of Security

2. The Head of Security is expected to keep the station, its crew, and its many assets safe at all costs.
3. The Head of Security is expected to swiftly coordinate the Security team to act in emergency situations.
4. The Head of Security is expected to fill in for any role in the Security department that is not currently being met. This includes hiring new Security force members when the team is too small to effectively handle station threats.
5. The Head of Security is expected to follow both Security and Command SOP, with the former taking priority to maintain station safety.
6. In situations where it is required, the Head of Security is to dismiss any Security member actively bringing shame to the Security team.
7. The Head of Security has final say over any and all imprisonments, unless other higher personnel on station state otherwise.
8. The Head of Security is to divulge as little information regarding corporate secrets to the station, including their Security team, as possible.
